//: Local-model agent gate. One caller (the agent) speaks the OpenAI chat format to the model route (a Foundry Local server on loopback - no upstream credential, no auth on that hop) and calls its tools through the tools route; both hops carry the agent's OWN Entra bearer (ADR-0004 caller tokens) and the caller-token rules are the tool boundary: the agent's named operations are the model call and the docs lookup, so an admin tool the model tries is refused 403 at the gate before the tool server ever sees it, and a well-formed token from a client id TokenClientIds does not name is refused 401 without moving anything. CallerToken keys: Authority = the OIDC issuer whose published metadata validates tokens (live: your Entra tenant v2 endpoint); Audience = a token minted for any other API is refused; MaxTokenAge = d.HH:mm:ss cap measured from iat. Operations are NAMED rules - a token is admitted only where its roles claim names the rule, so a token can narrow and never widen. The offline demo repoints Authority at the sample's own StubApi issuer and lists a demo client id through appsettings.Development.json (see README).

FoundryLocal.//: The model the agent sends when the runner's model gate exported nothing. scripts/live-run.sh validates THIS id against the local server's /v1/models before it creates any cloud resource and exports FOUNDRY_LOCAL_MODEL; the gate refuses the run instead of guessing, so a catalog entry that was never downloaded can never be picked by position.

Metrics.//: Console true prints the CredProx meter to stdout instead of exporting OTLP (the default endpoint OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT). Shorten OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL (ms, default 60000) for demos.
